title: CoreAudio is not available under certain conditions. (Windows)

labels.name: Confirmed
labels.description: This bug report has been confirmed by project members

body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST -->
<!-- The OBS Studio GitHub issue tracker is **ONLY** to be -->
<!-- used for reporting Bugs that have replication steps. -->

<!-- You can post Feature Requests here: https://ideas.obsproject.com/ -->
<!-- Get help for Support Issues here: https://obsproject.com/help -->

<!--- Provide a general summary of the issue in the Title above -->

## Platform
<!-- Please fill out the following information about your bug report. -->
<!-- If you are on Linux and installed using a package, please list the package type. -->
Operating system and version: Windows 10 2004
OBS Studio version: OBS Studio 26.0.0-rc3 (All versions available for CoreAudio)

## Expected Behavior
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
need to be able to use CoreAudio.

## Current Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior. -->
<!--- Please include a log file here if possible. -->
CoreAudio cannot be used when installing iTunes newly.
("AppleApplicationSupport.msi" and "AppleApplicationSupport64.msi" have been removed from the iTunes installer.)

## Steps to Reproduce
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant. -->
<!--- Screenshots and video are encouraged if applicable. -->
1. Prepare an environment where Apple Application Support (32bit) and Apple Application Support (64bit) is not installed.
2. Install iTunes (12.10.9.3).
3. Start OBS Studio.
4. View logfile.
```
[CoreAudio encoder]: Failed loading library 'CoreAudioToolbox.dll'
[CoreAudio encoder]: CoreAudio AAC encoder not installed on the system or couldn't be loaded
```

## Additional information
<!--- Not obligatory, but provide any additional details or information -->
<!--- that you feel might be relevant to the issue -->
https://hydrogenaud.io/index.php?topic=119889.0
*"CoreAudioToolbox.dll" is located in "C:\Program Files\iTunes\CoreAudioToolbox.dll".
(I use Google Translate. I apologize if my English is strange.)
